title: Types of Atmospheric Fronts
subject: Geography
description: A classification diagram illustrating the four main types of atmospheric fronts: Cold Front, Warm Front, Occluded Front, and Stationary Front, highlighting their characteristics.
mermaidCode:
graph TD
A[Atmospheric Fronts] --> B[Cold Front]
A --> C[Warm Front]
A --> D[Occluded Front]
A --> E[Stationary Front]
B -- Advancing cold air lifts warm air --> B1[Intense, brief precipitation]
C -- Warm air overrides cold air --> C1[Widespread, moderate precipitation]
D -- Cold front overtakes warm front --> D1[Warm sector lifted off ground]
E -- Neither air mass advances --> E1[Prolonged weather]
